rationale: Frozen from the v3 calibration artifact generated with the unique shape-matrix planner and negative-managed-counter guard. The largest native 500-1000 VmRSS endpoint rate was 888012.8 bytes per 100 requests; the 2000000-byte ceiling is a 2.25x margin and remains a POC limit. The 3000000000-byte Docker target reserves 600000000 bytes (20%) as deployment headroom. A separate 64000000-byte late-growth cap is 10.7% of that reserve; a 2 MB/100 rate projects to 50 MB across a 2500-request late segment. Managed heap uses half the process/RSS growth cap and unavailable samples block that segment. Peak/end tolerance is 5%; slope tolerance is 25% and invokes a third run when exceeded. R-squared 0.95 is a strict fit-quality criterion, never a standalone leak condition. The v1/v2 formal runs with other source identities are excluded from the v3 campaign. These are POC acceptance values, not formal outcomes or production SLA.
limitations: Native pilot requests used .NET 10.0.12／ONNX Runtime 1.30.0.0; a separate 500-request Docker pilot used .NET 8.0.31 and is not a matched replicate. One v3 1000-request native repeat had three negative GC.GetTotalMemory(false) samples, which were saved as null plus reason; these unavailable points are not used as numeric slope inputs. The native host cgroup limit is unavailable at the visible mount. The 2500-5000 late segment, full formal matrix and Docker 3000000000-byte target runs have not yet been completed. Collector/writer/latency buffer allocation was not isolated against a telemetry-disabled control. Any threshold change requires a new policy hash and campaign.
